name: CPEI Mixed Stick Curling Championship, Presented by Morley Annear Ltd.
description:
Dec. 8-11, 2026 @ Crapaud Comm. Curling Club

All participants must use a stick to deliver the rock. Teams must be made up of one female and one male.

All team members must be members in good standing with a Curl PEI member curling club and Curl PEI.

The PEI Stick Curling Committee is supporting this event and as a result entry fees have been lowered (from $100 to $85) for each team entering.

Communications will be sent to one team contact, as listed in the registration form, the team contact is responsible for sharing the information with the entire team.
